Inventory Reordering System

Problem Statement

Write a program to sort inventory items based on stock levels and identify critical items that need urgent attention.

An item is considered critical if its stock is less than 10 units.

Input Format

Line 1: Number of items (N)

Next N lines:
ItemName, Stock

Output Format

Display all items sorted in ascending order of stock, one per line in the format:
ItemName,Stock

Final line:
Comma-separated list of critical items (items with stock < 10), in the order they appear after sorting
